title: Last Wave (3/3): The Cove - The Finale

characters.Kai: src/anim/cast.py KAI - lucky red Hawaiian shirt, shorts, flip-flops; works at the boardwalk surf shop
characters.Tess: 15, customer, dark ponytail, yellow hoodie, brave but scared, has never surfed
characters.The infected: grey-green skin, torn clothes, white eyes, slow then fast; they will not go into water

scenes.narration: An infected lifeguard has Kai's ankle. Half a mile from shore. In the dark.
It pulled. The board tipped. Tess screamed.
Kai kicked. Once. Twice. And his flip-flop came off in its hand.
It held on to the flip-flop, instead of him.
And it sank. Still holding it.
Kai lay on his board, shaking. [kai] Could be worse. [kai] I had two of those.
Tess wasn't laughing. She was pointing at the beach.
The infected were still following them along the sand. Waiting.
So Kai looked for somewhere they couldn't reach.
Behind the rocks, a tiny cove. Cliffs on every side. No way down.
The infected reached the rocks, and couldn't climb.
Kai caught the last wave of the night. Tess too. Screaming the whole way in.
They lay on the sand until the sun came up.
At seven, a coast guard boat came around the point. Then a helicopter.
Shorts torn. One flip-flop. Sunburnt nose.
But somehow, the shirt survived. Not a mark on it.
Tess hugged him. [tess] You owe me a surf lesson. Kai laughed. [kai] Could be worse.
Would you have paddled out? Tell me. And follow for Kai's next worst day.
